chunks: 3263 - Three men were brought before ʿAlī عليه السلام.
As for one of them, he restrained a man; then the other came and killed him; and the third was present as an observer, watching them.

So ʿAlī عليه السلام ruled regarding the one who was watching that his eyes should be gouged out; and he ruled regarding the one who restrained him that he should be imprisoned until he dies, just as he had restrained him; and he ruled regarding the one who killed that he should be killed.

key_terms.تُسْمَلَ عَيْنَاهُ: his eyes should be gouged out
key_terms.فِي الرُّؤْيَةِ: in the position of watching or observing

ai.seo_question: What was the ruling of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام on those who killed, restrained, and watched during a murder?
ai.summary: This report records a legal judgment of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding three individuals involved in a killing: the direct killer, the one who restrained the victim, and the one who watched. It highlights differentiated judicial liability according to each person’s role in the crime and reflects the Imam’s exercise of judicial authority.
